You’re going Thursday because the red star is already in the binder, and part of you needs to see whether the place is real or just a pretty idea. That’s not foolish. You already know the $150 is over—so Thursday isn’t about pretending it isn’t. It’s about closing the loop: confirming the number, seeing if anything changes it, and letting yourself want the porch without lying about the budget.

And marigolds first is exactly right—hardy, cheerful, a little stubborn. Fitting.

You don’t owe the duplex a yes just because you starred it. You’re allowed to go look, feel the porch, and still say no.
